instruction: Project7 simplified RTC contract. Sparse sensors are reconstructed by Step1; Step2 predicts direct whole-system Delta-TFV for joint candidate actions; Step3 searches the frozen targeted-D3 control manifold. Model/observation step=5 min, supervisory update=10 min, first Proposed control=elapsed 60 min, value horizon=360 min, causal history=13 frames, and max setting delta=0.5 per 10-min update. Priority flooding and Global Peak are report-only diagnostics and do not gate or optimize the online policy.

objective.primary: minimize rainfall-ensemble risk-adjusted whole-system cumulative TFV

execution_freeze.runtime_benchmark_role: verify fixed 300 s compute budget and fixed readback tolerances only
